content: .{@-उपवीतम्@} the sacred thread worn by members of the first three classes (and now even of other lower castes) over the left shoulder and under the right arm; see <ls>Ms. 2. 63</ls>; वामांसावलम्बिना यज्ञोपवीतेनोद्भासमानः <ls>K.</ls>; कौशं सूत्रं त्रिस्त्रिवृतं यज्ञोपवीतम् … … <ls>Baudhāyana</ls>; (originally यज्ञोपवीत was the ceremony of investiture with the sacred thread).
